title: Electrical Motors - Locked Rotor Design Code Letters
description: NEMA locked rotor indicating code letters for electrical motors. Classifies motors by the ratio of locked rotor kVA per horsepower according to NEMA standards.

components.content:
## Standard 3 Phase Motors Locked Rotor Codes by Horsepower

- **Less than 1 hp**: Locked Rotor Code L, 9.0 - 9.99 kVA
- **1 1/2 to 2 hp**: Locked Rotor Code L or M, 9.0 - 11.19 kVA
- **3 hp**: Locked Rotor Code K, 8.0 - 8.99 kVA
- **5 hp**: Locked Rotor Code J, 7.1 - 7.99 kVA
- **7.5 to 10 hp**: Locked Rotor Code H, 6.3 - 7.09 kVA
- **More than 15 hp**: Locked Rotor Code G, 5.6 - 6.29 kVA

**Note**: Small motors generally require higher starting kVA than larger motors. The starting kVA required by a motor starting at full voltage is determined from the nameplate on the motor or from the manufacturer.
